**Workbench II**: the KOReader workbench grows up. The Bookends and Bookshelf pages are tidied into tabs and now cover almost everything both plugins offer — fonts, colours and conditions in Bookends, modules and new shelves in Bookshelf — and what you change in the full KOReader window can be kept. This release collects 2.2-beta1 to beta5.

## New

- **Tabs** on the Bookends page (*Lines*, *Progress bars*, *Preset*) and the Bookshelf page (*Appearance*, *Home*, *Navigation*, *Layout*, *All*); a red dot marks tabs with unsaved changes.
- **Bookends lines:** the six positions as a small page to click; tokens, special characters and format buttons (**B**, *I*, U, colour, condition, examples) right below the text; **font per line**; **conditions** (`[if:batt<20]…[else]…[/if]`) listed per line and edited in a small window; labels as in Bookends (*Extra bottom margin*, *Move line*).
- **Colours:** text, symbol and background colours of a preset; own colours, ticks and **markers** for progress bars and bars inside a line. On e-readers without a colour screen every colour field asks for a grey in % black, as Bookends does, and shows colours as the grey the device will display.
- **Bookshelf:** modules that need a choice (*Action*, *Shelf*, *Ornament*); **new shelves** from a folder, a collection, a stack per series and more; modules, start menu and shelves editable even before Bookshelf has written them.
- **Changes from KOReader:** what you change in the menus of *Open in KOReader* can be taken into the preview profile when the window closes.
- **Sleep screen patch** `2-bookbench-screensaver.lua` (attached to this release): the cover moves into the free space next to the sleep message instead of lying under it.
- Resizable columns in the workbench lists; the number of books is back next to *Library* in the sidebar.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy, or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_2.2.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
